statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The claim was denied with denial reason code CO-50
The service was not deemed medically necessary under current coverage guidelines
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes
The submitted clinical indication note documents the symptomatic episodes and underlying diagnosis that support the use of this diagnostic modality
